description: Defines structures, constants, and functions for handling certificate policies in the context of X.509 certificates, including parsing extensions like certificatePolicies, policyConstraints, and policyMappings.

classes.name: PolicyQualifierInfo
classes.description: Holds OID and qualifier data for policy qualifiers in certificate policies.

classes.name: PolicyInformation
classes.description: Represents a certificate policy with its OID and associated qualifiers.

methods.name: ParseCertificatePoliciesExtension
methods.description: Parses the certificatePolicies extension and extracts policy information.

methods.name: ParseCertificatePoliciesExtensionOids
methods.description: Parses the certificatePolicies extension and extracts policy OIDs.

methods.name: ParsePolicyConstraints
methods.description: Parses the PolicyConstraints extension as per RFC 5280.
